summary: Maintainer clarification has been recorded: devgod is a public package for full autonomous development-team behavior with runtime DB authority as canonical truth and downstream runtime authority by default. The repair roadmap, brief, task packet, queue, review exports, council packet, and product-state exports now point at this repair track. Phase 1 restored the maintainer quality path: idle workflow checks are intentional, stale completion-audit contract propagation is repaired, coverage passes above threshold, and `npm run check:quality` passes. Phase 2.1 defines runtime task, review, approval, and council records as canonical; markdown task packets, review summaries, product state, and task queue are export artifacts with explicit required/advisory semantics; `review_exports=runtime_optional` waives only markdown review summaries; live workflow checks now require non-empty completion-audit sections for `specialist_verified` or `completion_audit_required` tasks. Phase 2.2 adds derived approved-task proof obligations to status, surfaces missing or malformed approved task exports as contradictions when local workflow is non-active, and gives ops concrete repair and verification actions for the inspected run/task. Phase 2.3 repaired the approved `2026-06-08-consuming-repo-skill-evolution-trace-mining` export set by backfilling a current brief, task packet, structured progress proof, and runtime-verified review summaries. Phase 3.1 makes the package public, adds explicit JS `exports` and `bin` entrypoints, routes downstream installer scripts and workflow contract text through the public `devgod` command, and verifies a packed install can import `devgod` and run the bin. Runtime registration and final review-gate closure remain pending; Phase 3.2 command/setup surface consolidation is next.
